title: Sanyii Waldhabdee
intro: Addunyaan waldhabdee bal’aa ta’e osoo hin beekin qormaanni amantii fi ajajamuu gadi fagoon ni mul’ate. Seenaan kun filannoo namni dhuunfaa tokko godhu qorata, gochi isaa dhaloota dhufuuf fakkeenya ta’a. Oduu durii lubbuu hinaaffaa guddaa fi bu’aa isaa isa hamaa wajjin wal’aansoo qabdu hiikuuf qophaa’i.
clues: Sanyii jalqabaa lafa irra deeman keessaa tokkon ture, mucaa lamaan namoota jalqabaa keessaa tokko ture.
Anaafi obboleessi kiyya Rabbiif aarsaa akka dhiheessinu ajajamne, qormaata ikhlaasa keenyaaf.
Aarsaan koo fudhatama hin arganne, kan obboleessa koo garuu fudhatama argate, kunis garaa koo miira hamaadhaan guute.
Hadhaa diduutiin kan oofu obboleessa kootti jechoota doorsisaa dubbadhe.
Obboleessi kiyya haqa Rabbii fi sodaa Isaa na yaadachiise ogummaa fi quuqamaan deebii kenne.
Obboleessi koo dubbii lallaafaa fi dhiifama gochuuf fedhii qabaatus, lubbuu tokko fudhadhee, warra mo'aman keessaa tokko ta'e.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
